item.summary: Small hydropower uses the natural flow of rivers and canals to generate clean, reliable electricity. In India, projects with capacity up to 25 MW fall within this category. They suit hilly, remote areas where terrain limits larger projects and grid reach. India has an identified potential of 21,134 MW across 7,133 sites, of which about a quarter is harnessed. item.title: Harnessing Small Hydro Power
